policy.singleSource: This manifest is the only inventory used by the About page and license coverage checks.
policy.bundleLegalComments: android/tools/sdk/build.mjs intentionally uses legalComments:none; bundle comments are not the license source of truth.
policy.runtimeSnapshot: Validated against the existing .superpowers/tmp/v0.1.1-followup/dependencies.log when present; no new Gradle dependency report is generated by the license checks.
limitations: Android transitive coverage is checked from the existing dependency snapshot when available and from declared app/library dependencies otherwise; refresh this manifest after changing dependency versions or adding a new dependency group.
Generic META-INF exclusions are not proof of license coverage; a future dependency still needs its own manifest entry and original notice evidence.
Build-only esbuild packages are checked from package-lock.json but are intentionally hidden from the in-app runtime list because they are not packaged in the APK.
This archive covers bundled software and its source declarations only; it is not a legal opinion and does not cover user-supplied scripts or remote media/content.
